research_question: Can frozen Pool-P and S2-C complementarity be exploited by averaging or a small conditional selector?
averaging: mean sigmoid probabilities within expert, then weighted probability across experts
fixed_weight_selection: maximize training OOF correct; ties smallest Pool weight

gate.type: linear ridge regression of expected accuracy difference
gate.target: Pool selected correct minus S2 selected correct; both-wrong and both-correct target zero
gate.standardization: fit on these training rows only
gate.switch_rule: choose Pool iff predicted gain > 0 on answer disagreement, else S2

shared_policy: exclude invalid final candidates if any valid candidate; all-invalid fallback raw maximum; same numerical answer gate keeps S2
evaluation: six fresh official prediction plus independent scoring runs; six portable replays; question-paired descriptive bootstrap 10000 draws seed 20261017
validation_usage: Previously used development set; no validation-driven gate fitting, weight selection or protocol changes. Intervals descriptive, no multiple-comparison correction.
OOF_caveat: Base OOF rows genuinely held out. Gate fits all base OOF rows; its in-sample fit accuracy is not an unbiased meta-model cross-validation estimate. No nested-CV performance claim.
